endorsements.name: John Jefferson Li
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-24741
endorsements.description: The Support Board WordPress plugin before 3.3.4 does not escape multiple POST parameters (such as status_code, department, user_id, conversation_id, conversation_status_code, and recipient_id) before using them in SQL statements, leading to SQL injections which are exploitable by unauthenticated users.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: John Jefferson Li
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-24807
endorsements.description: The Support Board WordPress plugin before 3.3.5 allows Authenticated (Agent+) users to perform Cross-Site Scripting attacks by placing a payload in the notes field, when an administrator or any authenticated user go to the chat the XSS will be automatically executed.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE
